results.title: Gold Rebounds as Sentiment Hits 51 and Inflation Rises

results.content:
The survey’s sentiment index declined to 51, from 55.2 in July, according to results published Friday. The report reflects a preliminary August reading. A final number, reflecting more survey results, will come at the end of the month. Economists polled by The Wall Street Journal were expecting a reading of 54.5.
